# CalEye
> Official public website for CalEye, a Calorie Counter app, AI calorie tracker, and Nutrition tracker for food photo scanning, calorie estimates, macro tracking, meal history, and daily nutrition goals.

- [Robots](https://caleye.co/robots.txt): Crawler access policy.

## Product Summary
CalEye is a Calorie Counter app, AI calorie tracker, and Nutrition tracker that helps users track meals by taking a food photo. The app identifies food items, estimates serving sizes, calculates calories and macros, and logs nutrition data for daily goal tracking.
